description: This file implements logging utility functions for the HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) logger, including message formatting, initialization, and termination functions. It manages logging levels, outputs logs to stdout and stderr, and reads environment variables or files to configure verbose logging.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_Logger_Message(eMessageLevel level,const char * function,int line,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message based on the specified logging level and context (function, line). It supports verbose mode, adjusts output streams, and adheres to log level filtering.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleInit()
methods.description: Initializes the logging module, checks for specific files or environment variables to set verbose logging mode, and outputs initial log message.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleTerminate()
methods.description: Terminates the logging module with a log message.
